opinions.text: It having been reported to the Court that Gerald McNamara Chapman has been reinstated on the roll of attorneys admitted to practice in the State of Illinois, it is ordered that the order of this Court entered June 13, 1977 [431 U. S. 962], suspending Gerald McNamara Chapman from the further practice of law in this Court is vacated and that the rule to show cause issued June 13, 1977, is discharged.
